Peace and location

Below Cornštejn, close to the water

Panel stands in the holiday settlement of Chmelnice on the shore of the Vranov reservoir, below the ruins of Cornštejn castle. Outside the summer season it is quiet here: no traffic, just forest, water and your group. A loud party disturbs no one, yet Znojmo is only 35 minutes away.

  • Sandy beach about 100 m from the complex
  • Cornštejn ruins and Bítov castle within sight
  • Fenced complex, parking for 10 cars right next to it
  • Close to Podyjí National Park
